notes.title: NONAME replaces the Unity engine with another engine.
notes.content:
In the middle of December 2024, Visual Studio was having problems with memory issues.
This memory explosion appears to be a problem where the software is trying to support too many processes at once, which causes a lot of processes to start up in the manager and causes code to be eaten abnormally.
At the same time, suspected hackers made strange changes to the creator's code.
The original creator's design was such that when an enemy was killed with a Gobe sparring skill, the enemy's land would revert to empty land and move away.
However, the hacked game package has a bug that allows you to kill an enemy with Gobe sparring skill and not have it revert to empty land.
This hack is clearly just a silly prank that changes what the creator intended.

Originally, NONAME was about taking creations from stories and using them in a different way, like in tactics and strategy.
But when a third party changes the creator's principles, the creator is no longer creating, but strategizing as a tool.

Here's an example to help you understand what's happened.
Analogy 1: You're drawing a picture on a piece of paper, and someone rips it up.
Another example is if you're sculpting a brick, and someone breaks it.
Another example is if you're playing a musical instrument and someone breaks the strings.

So, I've come to the conclusion that we should move the engine.
We originally used Unity.
I've been using Unity since it didn't work with Visual Studio.
There was definitely a problem with the memory explosion.
I think this is what broke the code, and the fact that the Gobe sparring skill doesn't work well is also a possible hack.I think we need to move the engine.
Even now, if you run noname and try it, Gobe sparring skill doesn't work the way it used to.
We'll move the engine and fix this in the next update.
This process might take some time, so please be patient.

And my DiscatGames Rules.
discat games rule

1. DiscatGames creates games that are purely for fun.

2. we don't make games about real-world social issues, trends, or politics,
We make games that are quirky, creative, and epic.

3. If I need talent, I'm looking to build the future and want the right people.
We are short on pure capital right now, so partners will come later.
Please understand this.

4. We currently speak Korean and English.
When our net capital grows, we will support the languages of each country.

5. DiscatGames remains an indiegame - we don't use, and ignore, any language of numerology and promises.

http://discatgames.imweb.me/


We are currently working on a game that is much different and more advanced than the first one. We changed the engine and moved the whole game.
We're adding a main storyline and improving the interface and design to make it more accessible for beginners.
That's all for Discat from DiscatGames.

notes.title: NONAME ver0.87.18 EL UPDATE!
notes.content:
NONAME 0.87.189
l has been updated.
Below are the new additions

[previewyoutube=kTQ22Eqt5Ys;full][/previewyoutube]

-Faction El
The Secret Forest faction is located south of the center of the continent of Shizaka.
It is home to fairies and rubber man, and the Mystic Tree is said to be the birthplace of El.
It is said that the Woomp Tree gave birth to the Rubber man.
They use magic and bows, and especially those of general rank and above utilize “induce bows”.
The El are usually tranquil and peaceful, but when malicious forces emerge from the continent.
they are the secret guardians of the continent, and they are ruthless in their execution.

Additional units - El Guardian, Eagle Garrison, Secret Scouts, Donggre Troop, Golden Fruits Gathering, 
Stone Tree Troop.

El faction has also been added to Challenges.

Rubber Man
Humans are made of rubber, hence the name Rubber People.
They are immune to attacks from blunt weapons.

Induce Bow
The Induce Bow is a unique skill of the El faction.
It was created by the legendary blacksmith Tenjin, who imbued the bow with judo magic.
It can only be used by generals and above, and deals 1 damage to all longevity on the battlefield when used. 
	
List of bugs fixed.
Fixed a bug that prevented auto-saving when exiting mid-progress in Challenge Mode.
Fixed a bug where faction information would not be displayed when recreating a profile after deleting it.
Fixed a bug where the information on material icons and building icons would not display correctly.

*Tactics Online is under redevelopment. Available for all nation implementations.
*Please keep in mind that there are still undiscovered bugs and bugs in Multiplayer El Nations, and we will always update as we find them.

Future development progress.
We still have two more factions to complete: Woomer and Zipon.
After completing these two, we will develop a full story for NONAME.
The story will take place 5000 years after the Shizaka continent was renamed to the Seard continent, in a modern, civilized country with a game called NONAME, and NPCs will be playing against each other.
As we develop the story, we're going to drastically improve the AI.
After that, we will overhaul the UI, design, multisystems, and fix all bugs before releasing the game.
Thank you.
This is Discat from Discat Games.

notes.title: NONAME ver0.81.165 MAKIRACK UPDATE!
notes.content:
NONAME 0.81.165
Factions has been updated.
Below are the new additions

[previewyoutube=waMkne_6ZQ8;full][/previewyoutube]

-Makirac Faction
A faction located in the southwestern deserts of the Sizaka continent.
It is called the Duststorm, and is inhabited mostly by nomads and bandits.
The Makirack are located near a huge lake called “Hanasu”, which is made of volcanic water.
Added troops - Makirack Warriors, Shutard Elite, and Ragihwi Swordsmen, 
Gurr Masonry Troop, Attinan Troops

The Makirack faction has also been added to Challenges.

Tactical Rock
Makirack's unique skill.
Tactical Rocks are placed in an ally's formation, and once placed, they remain in place until the end of the game.
They are indestructible and cannot be taken away when an ally dies.
It scores x3 points per block in your construction score.

Two Spears
Makirack's unique spear technique.
Attacks with two spears deal one-half of the enemy's health.

Time Control
Time Control is the unique skill of Ometast the Priest.
It can only be used in multiplayer and reduces the opponent's second reading by 30 seconds.

Changed.
Added the Loot Talent to Baram Deano and Daero Gisaya in the Sukatarr Troops.
Added the Loot Talent to Madosus from the Dudak Troops and changed his rank from Centurion to Captain.
	
List of fixed bugs.
Playbook materials would turn white when attacking Peltu.(Fixed)
Bug with soldiers in formation being overpainted.(Fixed)
Computer Todora's soldiers could sometimes be picked up by players.(Fixed)
Burning Warriors final unit Koista would not activate.(Fixed)
Complete victory not applying on the computer.(Fixed)
When performing Todora, the FieldID would read 10000.(Fixed)
Kobe Sprring would not recognize a win after being moved. (Fixed)


*Tactics Online is under redevelopment. Available for all nation implementations.
*There are still undiscovered bugs and bugs in the Makirack faction in multiplayer, so please keep this in mind and we will always update as we find them.
Thank you.

notes.title: NONAME ver0.75.145b Jeal Volcanoes has been updated!
notes.content:
NONAME 0.70.136b
Factions has been updated.
Below are the new additions.

[previewyoutube=vy7cite_vzA;full][/previewyoutube]

-Jeal Volcanoes faction
A faction located in the center of the continent of Shizaka.
The second highest mountain on the continent, the Volcano of Jealousy is also the oldest.
Within it exists a nation of volcanic people, 
There is a village called “Agspontinan”.

Added troops - burning warriors.

The Jeal Volcanoes faction has also been added to Challenges.

Spontaneous Ignition
Unique skill of the Burning Warriors.
When a Volcanoes dies on the battlefield, it spontaneously combusts, automatically clearing the surrounding enemy territory.

Flaming Sword
Flaming Warrior's unique weapon.
When hit by the flaming sword, 1 health is removed each turn.

What's New.
Added the concept of “Winning”.
When a unit is placed, it is picked up if all of its troops are completely undamaged, or if all of its troops are victorious, even if it is a total victory.
Winning results in the awarding of material points equal to the current number of rounds.
The concept of a Winning was created to help secure matches with large skill differentials.
	
List of fixed bugs.
When placing a unit after shooting the inevitable bow, a dead unit sound effect would play (fixed).
Country names were being truncated in country descriptions (fixed).
Bug with material items appearing white (fixed.)


*Tactics Online is under redevelopment. Available for all nation implementations.
*There are still undiscovered bugs and bugs in the Jeal Volcanoes faction in multiplayer, so please keep this in mind and we will always update as we find them.
Thank you.

notes.title: NONAME ver0.55.32 Todora Update!
notes.content:
NONAME 0.55.32
This is a big update.

New.
- Added Todora factions.
 Factions have been created with unique personalities that move one space in each direction. 
- Added a challenge system.
Challenges can only be taken once per profile.
A challenge in which you must defeat all of the other three nations' armies with your chosen nation.
If you succeed, you will receive a trophy along with your accumulated points.
If you fail, the challenge disappears without any reward.
Of course, you can delete your existing profile and recreate it, and the challenge system will be available again.
- The rules of combat have changed slightly with the addition of two systems.
1. Material system.
You score points on the battlefield as you pick up drops for each rank.
2. the Judgment System.
  At the end of the battle, buildings are built based on the shape of the territory you control, and 
 additional points are awarded based on the value of the buildings.
 Wins and losses are determined by the sum of your Material Score and Decision Score.
- Added a ranking system.
The ranking system is multi-score only, and you can see where you stand as long as you're on the server.
- In addition, we've added a handy feature where you can hover over skill icon to see a description.

List of bug fixes.
Fixed a bug with shields showing over the bow east infinite.
Fixed a bug where ranks were not displayed correctly in multiplayer.
Fixed a bug where the last turn opponent's green screen would not return in matches against the computer.
Fixed a bug where the main profile rating would get stuck at 0.
Fixed a bug that caused Amancago's soldier names to appear green.
Fixed a bug that caused the order to be shuffled when playing as a Silent Swordsman.
Fixed a bug where using Todora's skill in a corner would leave items in place.
Fixed a bug where Fortress items would not work.
Fixed a bug where food items would not work.
Fixed a bug where you could defeat two teams in a challenge, but only one would die when you opened the challenge system.

*Please keep in mind that there are still bugs we haven't found yet, as well as bugs in the Todora nation in multiplayer, and we will always update as we find them.

Thank you.
This was Discat for Discat Games.
